name: @interval/vscode
description: Your coding agent's status and a quick session that fits the wait, from Interval.

interval.url.markdownDescription: Your Interval site, for example `https://interval.example`. https only; plain http only for `localhost`, `127.0.0.1` and `::1`.

scripts.package: pnpm build && node scripts/stage.mts && cd dist/vsix && vsce package --no-dependencies --skip-license --allow-missing-repository --out ../../interval.vsix
scripts.test:host: pnpm build && node scripts/stage.mts && esbuild test-host/suite.ts --bundle --format=cjs --platform=node --target=node20 --external:vscode --outfile=dist/test-host/suite.js && node test-host/run.mts
